messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm drafting the internal RN for tomorrow's deploy (v2026.2). Can folks eyeball the short blurb and flag any risky items?

sam: link to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rn/v2026.2 (wip) — added TL;DR and known issues section.

priya: I have a small note about embeddings quant toggle causing a perf dip in staging — added a one-line mitigation under 'Known Issues'.

alex: @priya good call. Can you add a one-line rollback sentence: 'If embedding latency regresses >15% in canary, rollback to v2026.1 pin'?

priya: done. phrasing: "Rollback to v2026.1 pin if canary SSE latency +15% over baseline for 5m" — happy to iterate.

maria: Quick question — are we pinning the hosted model to a specific quantized build or using the runtime fallback? Need to call out in RN and which teams to ping on rollback.

alex: We'll pin hosted to model-green-2026-quant (sha: abc123) for this launch. Add contact: @maria @jamie for rollback ops.

jamie: Noted. I'll be on standby during the canary window. I added a short runbook snippet in the doc with the rollback command and smoke checks.

alex: Great. Can we schedule the canary between 02:00-02:30 UTC (low traffic)? Also plan a 30m quiet window after successful canary before wider rollout.

sam: Deploy bot scheduled canary: see below. I updated the RN timeline and the deploybot cue.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job created: canary/v2026.2 @ 2026-05-12T02:05:00Z -> targets: 5% traffic, region: us-west-2. Health checks: p99 latency, error-rate, embed-throughput. Notify channel on completion.

priya: I added the canary metrics we should watch: p50/p95/p99 latency, errors, embedding token throughput, kv cache hit rate. Will surface a short eval script in the doc.

sam: RN also contains comms blurb for PMs + support. Kept it short: what changed, expected impact, how to reach ops.

maria: One more ask — legal requested we keep the microcopy minimal for public-facing notes; internal RN can have the deeper details. Confirmed.

alex: Perfect. Final checklist: 1) RN doc link up-to-date (sam) 2) Runbook snippet + rollback command (jamie) 3) Canary scheduled (deploy-bot) 4) Ops standby (jamie, priya) 5) Pin sha in RN (maria). If all green I'll post the internal announcement at 18:00 PT today.

jamie: All items ✅ from my side.

priya: ✅ I'll monitor the canary dashboard and post a quick summary after 10m.

sam: ✅ doc ready for final copyedit.

alex: Posting internal announce at 18:00 PT unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: go ahead.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-12T17:50:00Z -> channel eng-releases (internal announce preflight).

alex: Thanks team — will post the announce and pin the RN in #eng-releases when live.
